about.title: Game Instructions
rulesContent: Click on the level button to start the corresponding level
Each question will display the first part of the riddle
Choose the correct second part from three options
You will immediately see if your answer is correct
After completing all questions, your accuracy and rating will be displayed
featureContent: Random Questions: The order of questions is randomly shuffled each time you start a level
Random Answers: Some questions have multiple correct answers, and one is randomly selected each time
Random Distractors: Distractor options also change randomly, increasing game challenge
Accuracy Statistics: Real-time statistics and display of answer accuracy
PK Mode: Supports two-player battle, real-time competitive answering, increasing game fun
about.tipsContent: Jimi language is a traditional Nanbei Lvdou in Hagu, usually consisting of two parts: the first part is the Haqi, and the second part is the baboon. You can think about it in combination with Hajimi when answering Nanbei questions.

help.title: Game Help
gameRulesContent: Click on the level button to start the corresponding level
Each question will display the first part of the riddle
Choose the correct second part from three options
You will immediately see if your answer is correct
After completing all questions, your accuracy and rating will be displayed
tipsContent: Riddles usually consist of two parts: metaphor and explanation
Pay attention to homophones and puns
Combine common sense and cultural background
If you're unsure, try the elimination method
help.noteContent: Playing more times can improve your accuracy!
